implementationDetails.audioStrategy: One Web Audio AudioContext realizes the browser signal path. The Phase 3 instrument is a single System4 pure-DSP engine that mixes the Piano (2 layers), Organ (2 layers sharing one effect chain) and Synth (3 layers with independent effect chains) into ONE shared Rotary and ONE master GainNode (Master Level) + DynamicsCompressor limiter feeding exactly one destination, realized by one SystemGraph drain node — no second AudioContext, nothing bypasses the master path. Each effect chain keeps the documented order (Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp Sim/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, then Rotary when routed). The engine is deterministic and sample-accurate, so tests render real PCM and prove every engine/model/drawbar/wave/filter/envelope/morph/split/scene changes the audio; the browser context is injectable so graph tests verify one context, one destination, and full cleanup. Grand, Upright, and Electric remain bundled, offline, redistributable multi-root/multi-velocity sample libraries generated deterministically (many root notes across E1..E7 plus three velocity layers) and rendered as committed WAV assets under public/samples; Clav, Digital, and Misc are honest live synthesis (piano spec sourceRules); the Organ and Synth engines are honest live additive/oscillator synthesis. Generated sample tables and DSP are truthfully declared as generated, never as field recordings.
